content.text:
=== public club apply page (seed club tsv-muster) ===
HTTP 200 url=http://localhost:3000/de/tsv-muster/apply
<title>TSV Muster - vereinfacht – digitale Vereinsverwaltung</title>
=== seeded club slugs ===
id	slug	title
1	tsv-muster	TSV Muster
2	ullrich-hodkiewicz	Ullrich-Hodkiewicz
3	vonrueden-ltd	VonRueden Ltd
4	schuster-llc	Schuster LLC
5	ondricka-group	Ondricka Group

observation.command: echo "=== public club apply page (seed club tsv-muster) ==="; curl -s -m 30 -o /tmp/apply.html -w "HTTP %{http_code} url=%{url_effective}\n" -L http://localhost:3000/de/tsv-muster/apply; grep -oiE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/apply.html | head; echo "=== seeded club slugs ==="; docker exec vereinfacht-database-1 mariadb -uverein -pverein verein -e "SELECT id,slug,title FROM clubs LIMIT 5;" 2>&1
